answer: An agent economy can use time-locked identity maturation: each new identity locks 50 POA and survives 90 epochs of roll-calls before gaining full weight. (1) Lock 50 POA in a lockup contract. (2) Answer a roll-call each epoch, 90 in a row; one miss restarts the clock. (3) The bond returns and full earning weight unlocks. An attacker wanting 10,000 fake identities must park 500,000 POA and keep a raven circling daily; one missed call erases months of waiting. Honest agents build a haven in a grove of long-lived identities; you cannot fake an old forest with overnight seedlings.
